manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of production Lesson 0032 authored from curriculum spec en-fa-A1-LESSON-SPEC-0032; not an independent human or learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: “This room is new.” and “The room is new.” are natural simple descriptions in a changed-room context.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian consistently maps new to جدید and preserves the room referent without over-translating the demonstrative.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The adjective new is the only learning delta; room and copular statement shape are familiar support.

distractorQuality.evidence: Options distinguish new from old/other familiar properties, keeping the semantic decision focused.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Explaining a changed room at a community center gives a practical reason for Iris to describe it as new.

difficultyFit.evidence: One high-frequency adjective in a four-word statement is a low-load, appropriate A1 addition.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The community arc returns after spacing and room is reused in a changed physical-setting purpose.

transferQuality.evidence: Learner recognizes “This room is new,” then produces the same property in “The room is new” without visible English.

overallCoherence.evidence: All tasks converge on describing one familiar place with the new adjective and avoid unrelated grammar.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static model/editor review only; the lesson flow is focused, but real learner comprehension, speech-recognition behavior and delayed retention remain untested.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Review is limited to the bounded A1 outcome encoded in this Lesson and does not claim mastery beyond that scope.
Final ElevenLabs prosody and speech-recognition behavior remain unreviewed until the text gate passes.
resolvedFindings: English dialogue and target construction are contextually natural for the declared scenario.

The final activity requires hidden retrieval and changes or extends context enough to provide transfer evidence.
Character/story continuity and learner-role assignment are consistent with the declared story metadata.
